name: Recovery Controller
description: The recovery controller reconciles desired state with actual state. Detects and repairs inconsistencies.
purpose: Maintain system integrity by continually reconciling desired task state against actual execution state.
acceptanceCriteria: Recovery controller periodically reconciles desired state vs actual state
Inconsistencies (orphaned tasks, ghost assignments, missed completions) are detected
Repairs are applied automatically for known inconsistency patterns
Repair actions are logged and auditable
Recovery controller has bounded impact on normal scheduling operations
Controller can be manually triggered for on-demand reconciliation
